overview: The Medford Energy and Environment Committee received updates on city sustainability programs and proposed local tree ordinances before reviewing potential 2024 committee initiatives. Members categorized prospective projects into core focus areas for the co-chairs to refine ahead of the April meeting.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The committee approved the minutes from the February 5 meeting.

items.title: Municipal Staff Updates
items.summary: Pike reported on progress with Electrify Medford coach recruitment, the rollout of citywide curbside composting, upcoming municipal aggregation bidding, building code trainings, and pending state climate legislation.

items.title: Trees Medford and Tree Ordinances Update
items.summary: James previewed Arbor Day events and summarized recent discussions with city councilors on draft tree ordinances, noting concerns regarding municipal enforcement capacity, tree canopy goals, and mitigation fee structures.

items.title: 2024 Committee Priorities
items.summary: The committee reviewed past initiatives and organized proposed 2024 projects under categories such as local decarbonization, school outreach, community interaction, and ecological restoration, agreeing that committee chairs will consolidate the list for finalization at the next meeting.
